44.primary_facts: Table 1 and Text S1 both give CIS=(cGMP AND cADPR) OR (InsP3 AND InsP6). The paper describes 40 dynamic nodes and asynchronous updates. Table 1 and Text S1 give different ROS expressions (ABA AND PA AND pHc versus Atrboh).
44.mapping_limit: No source-declared numerical index mapping from the 44-node public code to this primary model was recovered. Natural matching suggests node 16=CIS, but this remains inferred.
44.own_code_deductions_under_candidate_mapp: Inferred Depolar=node 18 uses regulators four positions lower than the corresponding Table 1 names. Inferred Closure=node 17 is 0 in the supplied target. These additional mismatches prevent a single OR replacement from certifying the whole model.
